definition: sha256 over UTF-8 lines '<key>\t<value>\n' sorted by line; a file's key is its repo-relative posix path, its value the sha256 of its bytes. design_sha covers design.py (or source.svg and palette.yaml) and every file in data/, plus a 'variant\t<name>' line for a named variant.
